Automated analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal text reuse, identifying 67 matching passages shared with nine other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Milindapañha* itself, the dialogue shares substantial phrasing with the *Dukkarakārikapañha* (Mil 6.3.2), the *Khīṇāsavabhāvapañha* (Mil 6.2.2), the *Nibbānasacchikaraṇapañha* (Mil 6.3.11), the *Dhammavinayapaṭicchannāpaṭicchannapañha* (Mil 5.4.2), and the *Nibbānarūpasaṇṭhānapañha* (Mil 6.3.10) [DharmaNexus]. In canonical texts, it shares passages with the *Bodhirājakumāra Sutta* (MN 85, §1.1_3–1.1_4 ↔ §30.5–30.6), the *Gāmaṇi Saṁyutta* (SN 42), and the *Brahma Saṁyutta* (SN 6, §1.1_5–2.4 ↔ §14.6.1–14.6.4), as well as the commentary to the *Ekakanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus additionally aligns segments of the text with Tibetan translations, notably the *Bodhisattvagocara-upāyaviṣayavikurvāṇanirdeśa-sūtra* (D0146) and the *Abhiniṣkramaṇa-sūtra* (D0301) [DharmaNexus].
